questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: It was in this room (   ) the meeting was held.
questions.explanation: It was 〜 that … の強調構文。副詞句（in this room）を強調している。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He (   ) come, but he left soon.
questions.explanation: did + 動詞の原形 で「確かに〜した」と強調。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This is, (   ) I know, the best restaurant in town.
questions.explanation: as far as I know（私の知る限り）は挿入句。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: We visited Kyoto, (   ) ancient capital of Japan.
questions.explanation: Kyoto と the ancient capital of Japan は同格。「日本の古都である京都」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.explanation: 疑問詞 + on earth で「いったい〜」と強調する。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He did not say a (   ) word.
questions.explanation: not a single 〜 で「ただの1つも〜ない」と強調。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: It was not until he lost his health (   ) he realized its value.
questions.explanation: It was not until ... that ...「〜して初めて…」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: It is you (   ) are to blame.
questions.explanation: 強調構文で人を強調するときは who も使える。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I do (   ) that you will succeed.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 do で動詞を強調。原形になる。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He was late, (   ) is often the case with him.
questions.explanation: as is often the case with 〜「〜にはよくあることだが」。as は前後の内容を受ける関係代名詞。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: There is no doubt (   ) he will succeed.
questions.explanation: no doubt の内容を説明する同格の that。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
(   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: All you (   ) do is wait here.
questions.explanation: All you have to do is (to) 〜「〜しさえすればよい」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I have not the (   ) idea what he means.

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
(   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I (   ) hope you will come again.
questions.explanation: 動詞の前の do は強調「本当に」。
